rendererOnlyChanges.approvalImpact: none; renderer code is outside lesson digests
rendererOnlyChanges.summary: For activities explicitly marked off-screen, quantity, group-and-match and look-and-name now render only a handoff and useful static references. They no longer invent counters, graded choices, sorting targets or completion praise. Hands-on pictures are labelled as examples rather than exact physical setups.
rendererOnlyChanges.semanticConfirmation: The canonical child instruction, adult guidance, objectives, progression, durations and safety text are unchanged by this system correction.
rendererOnlyChanges.reviewQuestion: Confirm that this presentation preserves the approved off-screen activity rather than adding or removing pedagogy.

reviewerInstructions.independence: Decide pedagogical acceptability independently. Passing tests and audit provenance are technical evidence only.
requiredOutput: verdict for each affected change or an explicit verdict covering a named set
exact requested correction for every non-accepted item
separate verdict for each new media asset
reviewerInstructions.approvalRule: No approval may be restored until an accepted decision is recorded. Accepted-with-modifications and rejected items remain at review.
